verdict.rationale: GitHub documents an official GitHub MCP server that lets agents work with repositories, issues, pull requests and other GitHub features. That is the same data and workflow GitHub Mobile surfaces, but the server is a GitHub-platform capability documented for IDE Copilot Chat, not a feature of the mobile app itself. Missing for 10: any MCP server tied to or exposed by GitHub Mobile, setup and auth details for connecting external agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
